title: Trump says execution of Fort Hood shooter will not be livestreamed

blocks.text: Jenipher Camino Gonzalez with AP, Reuters, AFP, dpa

Trump said the execution of the Fort Hood shooter can be viewed in person by families of the victims if they wish. The decision comes after bipartisan backlash regarding the Pentagon's plans to livestream the execution.
US President Donald Trump said on Thursday the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will not be livestreamed.
This is a breaking news story and will be updated....
